title: All 17 scenarios passed — Scene object lifecycle observation-aware
summary: All 17 integration scenarios passed (100% pass rate). The PR makes Scene object lifecycle observation-aware: objects are marked missing only after repeated healthy, depth-verified absences, not by wall-clock staleness. New configuration keys (period_s, visible_miss_frames, visibility_depth_margin_m, object_ttl_s) are added to the manifest and driver. A new live Webots dropout verifier and unit tests validate the behavior. The CI exercised builtin, capability, and flow scenarios including camera, lidar, mapping, memory, navigation, explore, speech, voiceprint, and scene operations.
pr_changes: Added perception configuration (period_s, visible_miss_frames, visibility_depth_margin_m, object_ttl_s) to robonix_manifest.yaml
Updated system/scene/README.md with driver configuration documentation and legacy env var deprecation

Major refactor of perception_concept_graphs.py: added _observed_map_object_uuids, _visible_missing_uuids, _finish_healthy_frame, _purge_expired_map_objects_locked; modified _project_to_registry and _apply_snapshot to accept observed_uuids, visible_miss_uuids, frame_seq, observed_at; added visible_miss_threshold, visibility_depth_margin_m, object_ttl_s constructor params; added reset_derived_state method
Updated service.py to parse perception config from manifest, pass new params to detector, wire derived_state_reset into lifecycle_watch and web app
Added observation_lifecycle attribute check in object_registry.py mark_stale to skip visibility-tracked objects
Updated web.py to accept and call derived_state_reset on map load
Updated test_lifecycle_flush.py and test_map_epoch.py to verify derived_state_reset is called
Added new test_observation_lifecycle.py with unit tests for historical projection, visible misses, depth visibility, epoch reset, and TTL pruning
Updated test_scene_graph.py to verify clear_derived_state clears caches
Added testing/verify_scene_object_dropout.py live Webots verifier script
test_result: All 17 scenarios passed (17/17, 100%). Coverage includes builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command), cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memgraph_failure_lesson, memgraph_roundtrip, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), and flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe) scenarios. The CI exercised the full Webots simulation stack: camera, lidar, mapping, navigation, explore, speech, voiceprint, memory, and scene services.

suggested_fix: No fix needed. Monitor the new scene_object_dropout scenario in future runs to ensure the observation-aware lifecycle works end-to-end with live Webots fixtures.
risks_or_watchouts: The new observation-aware lifecycle may change behavior for objects that go out of FOV or are occluded — they will no longer be marked missing by wall-clock staleness alone.
The scene_object_dropout scenario was added but not executed in this run (it requires a live Webots fixture); it should be verified in a full simulation run.
Legacy SCENE_OBJECT_TTL_SEC env var is now a compatibility override; new deployments should use the manifest config.
The LLM ranker in memgraph failed twice (JSONDecodeError) and fell back to chronological order — this is expected when the VLM endpoint returns non-JSON.
